table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,   
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc,  
		/*saleordercode=0,
		saleorderremarks='',
		saleorderdate='',*/
		saleordercode=(select saleordercode from saleorderdetail where rowid=issuedetail.saleorderrowid),
		saleorderremarks=(select remarks from saleorderheader where saleorderheader.saleordercode=(select saleordercode from saleorderdetail where rowid=issuedetail.saleorderrowid)),
		saleorderdate=(select date from saleorderheader where saleorderheader.saleordercode=(select saleordercode from saleorderdetail where rowid=issuedetail.saleorderrowid)),
		itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode), 
		genericname=(select name from genericitem where item.genericcode=genericitem.genericcode),
		manf=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
         city= dbo.customer.city,
         licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
         username= dbo.users.username,   
         issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.issueheader.headerno,   
         date = dbo.issueheader.date , 
         gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
         icode = issuedetail.icode,   
         batch = issuedetail.batch,   
         expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
         looseqty = issuedetail.qty,   
         packunits= issuedetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= issuedetail.saleprice,   
         Id = dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=issueheader.posted,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
		dbo.issueheader.referenceno,	
		dbo.issueheader.remarks,
		salesman=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.salesman.name)),
		CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME

    FROM issueheader LEFT OUTER JOIN SalesMan ON (dbo.issueheader.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode),   
         issuedetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_SInvCode  ) AND  
        
			( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND 
			( dbo.issueheader.acccode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
          ( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode,
			dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL
